# Cluster side — the pinned lab environment, installed INSIDE the container.
# This is the file that prevents "works for me" version drift between students.
#
# Rules:
#   * every line is pinned to an exact version (==), never a range;
#   * change a pin only with a reason, and tell the lab (PR to this repo);
#   * torch/CUDA are NOT here — they come from the base image (env/Dockerfile),
#     because pip-upgrading torch on top of a CUDA image is the single most
#     common way to break a working pod.
nvidia-ml-py==12.560.30
transformers==4.46.3
accelerate==1.1.1
datasets==3.1.0
numpy==1.26.4
